def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    face_value = 5_000_000
    coupon_rate = 0.025
    market_rate = 0.03
    years = 3

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate
    bond_value = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + market_rate) ** period)
        for period in range(1, years + 1)
    )
    bond_value += face_value / ((1 + market_rate) ** years)

    # return answer
    return round(bond_value, 3)
